title: Understanding the Slope
text: Think about what the slope represents in a linear regression model. It tells us how much the response variable changes for each unit increase in the predictor variable.

title: Focus on the Predictor
text: In this model, the predictor is the hours spent on campus. Consider how changes in this variable might affect the number of rides taken.

hintAnswer: Estimated average ride increase per additional hour on campus.
